case: NACA 0012, SA, no point vortex -- NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource numerics study
why: The TMR page saved here (naca0012numerics_val_sa_withoutpv.html) contains no numeric data at
all: it links to the data files. Without them the only reference we hold for this case is the
three-code force table, which cannot say WHERE a drag discrepancy lives. The converged
roe_wls_venk variant (16 Sept) is +43.7 % on pressure drag while friction is +2.1 % and lift
+1.0 %, and localising that to the suction peak or the aft surface needs surface cp and cf.
source_note: Taken from the TMBWG/turbmodels GitHub repository, which the saved HTML page links to
directly. The page carries no absolute turbmodels.larc.nasa.gov URL of its own, so the
GitHub links are the only provenance the file itself supports -- these were not fetched from
